questions.questionText:
In a map based on the UTM projection, the grid distance is in error with respect to
the geodetic distance by about one in four thousand. If the map distance is 3 cm and
the map scale is 1:25,000, then the geodetic distance is_________ m (rounded off to
2 decimal places).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 749.79 to 750.20.

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section I (Surveying and Mapping)
questions.questionText:
A level with the height of the instrument being 2.550 m has been placed at a station
having a Reduced Level (RL) of 130.565 m. The instrument reads 3.665 m on a
levelling staff held inverted at the bottom of a bridge deck. The RL of the bottom of
the bridge deck is______m (rounded off to 3 decimal places).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 136.770 to 136.790.

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section I (Surveying and Mapping)
questions.questionText:
In levelling between two points P and Q on opposite banks of a river, the level was
set up near P, and the staff reading on P and Q were 2.165 m and 3.810 m,
respectively. The level was then moved and set up near Q and the respective staff
readings on P and Q were 0.910 m and 2.355 m. The true difference of level between
P and Q is______ m (rounded off to 3 decimal places).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 1.540 to 1.550.

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section I (Surveying and Mapping)
questions.questionText:
A 23 cm square format camera with a focal length of 152.4 mm is used for taking
vertical aerial photographs with 60% end-lap. These photographs are viewed under a
stereoscope with a base-height ratio of 0.15. The vertical exaggeration while
stereoviewing these photographs is __________ (Answer in integer).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 4 to 4.

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section II (Image Processing and Analysis)
questions.questionText: Which one of the following image processing methods employs standard deviation?
options: Correction of skew distortion in raw satellite image

richOptions.text: Correction of skew distortion in raw satellite image

questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by IIT Roorkee is Option (B).

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section II (Image Processing and Analysis)
questions.questionText:
Which one of the following is NOT used to assess the quality of remote sensing
image?
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by IIT Roorkee is Option (D).

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section II (Image Processing and Analysis)
questions.questionText:
Which one of the following techniques is NOT used to atmospherically correct the
satellite image?
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by IIT Roorkee is Option (C).

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section II (Image Processing and Analysis)
questions.questionText:
A remote sensing instrument measures only in Green, Red and Near-Infrared
frequency bands. The remote sensing index/indices that CANNOT be derived using
data of this instrument is/are______.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by IIT Roorkee for this MSQ is B;D.

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section II (Image Processing and Analysis)
questions.questionText:
Principal Component Analysis is performed on a 4-band IRS satellite image. The
eigen values (𝐸 = [𝜆 , 𝜆 , 𝜆 , 𝜆 ]) computed from the covariance matrix are

decimal places).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 3.71 to 3.75.

questions.questionText:

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section II (Image Processing and Analysis)
questions.questionText:
A CCD array element in a remote sensing sensor measures incoming radiation and
its output voltage varies linearly between 0 V to 5 V. This voltage is converted to
an 8-bit digital image using an analogue to digital convertor (ADC). The ADC has
a linear response without bias or noise. If the output image pixel has a digital
number of 100, the input voltage to the ADC would be _____ V (rounded off to 2
decimal places).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 1.95 to 1.97.

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section II (Image Processing and Analysis)
questions.questionText:
In supervised digital image classification, the number of combinations to be
evaluated to select three best bands out of five bands is___________ (Answer in
integer).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 10 to 10.

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section II (Image Processing and Analysis)
questions.questionText:
The figure below shows a one-dimensional function, 𝑓, and a filter 𝑤. Consider 𝑓
is padded with zeros on both sides. Which one among the following will be the final
convolution output of 𝑓 with 𝑤 after the padding zeros are removed from the
output?
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by IIT Roorkee is Option (C).

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section II (Image Processing and Analysis)
questions.questionText:
Figure below shows the scatterplot of training pixels of water (w), sand (s), forest
(f) and commercial (c) in bands 1 and 2. Pixel ‘A’ having digital number 4 and 6
in band 1 and band 2, respectively, is to be classified using k-nearest neighbor
classifier having the value of k equal to 5. The assigned class for the pixel ‘A’ is
_____.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by IIT Roorkee is Option (B).

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section II (Image Processing and Analysis)
questions.questionText:
Consider an imaging system with 128 128 pixels that produces a noiseless,
distortion-free digital image. It is used to digitize checkerboard patterns where all
squares of the pattern are in the field of view. Using this imaging system, if a
checkerboard pattern with 128 128 squares is digitized, each square will be
1 1 pixel in size. What is the size of the checkerboard square in the generated
digital image for which spatial aliasing is observed (measured in pixels of the
imaging system)?
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by IIT Roorkee is Option (C).

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section II (Image Processing and Analysis)
questions.questionText:
For the correlation matrix of a 4-band satellite image as shown below, which of the
following statements is/are correct?
options: Band 3 provides some unique information not found in other bands
There is high redundancy in band 2 and 4
The standard deviation of all the bands is equal
Image cannot be classified using bands 1 and 3 only

richOptions.text: Band 3 provides some unique information not found in other bands
There is high redundancy in band 2 and 4
The standard deviation of all the bands is equal
Image cannot be classified using bands 1 and 3 only

questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by IIT Roorkee for this MSQ is A;B.

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section II (Image Processing and Analysis)
questions.questionText:
The histogram of a red band in a 3-bit satellite image is shown below. Which of
the following statements is/are correct?
options: There are more darker pixels in the image
There are more brighter pixels in the image
The mean digital number of the image is 1250

It may be predicted that approximately 40% of area in the image is covered by
material with low spectral albedo in red band

richOptions.text: There are more darker pixels in the image
There are more brighter pixels in the image
The mean digital number of the image is 1250

It may be predicted that approximately 40% of area in the image is covered by
material with low spectral albedo in red band

questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by IIT Roorkee for this MSQ is A;D.

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section II (Image Processing and Analysis)
questions.questionText:
Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding across-track scanning
sensor of an airborne optical imaging system?
options: The relief displacement will be along the direction of the flight line
There is no relief displacement along the direction of the flight line

The greater is the distance of the ground object from nadir, the lesser is the image
scale compression

richOptions.text: The relief displacement will be along the direction of the flight line
There is no relief displacement along the direction of the flight line

The greater is the distance of the ground object from nadir, the lesser is the image
scale compression

questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by IIT Roorkee for this MSQ is B;D.

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section II (Image Processing and Analysis)
questions.questionText:
In case of normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI), which of the following
statements is/are correct?
options: It is functionally equivalent to a simple ratio of red to near infra-red reflectance
It reduces many forms of multiplicative noise
It is sensitive to canopy background variations

richOptions.text: It is functionally equivalent to a simple ratio of red to near infra-red reflectance
It reduces many forms of multiplicative noise
It is sensitive to canopy background variations

questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by IIT Roorkee for this MSQ is A;B;D.

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section II (Image Processing and Analysis)
questions.questionText:
The hue, intensity and saturation values for a pixel are 𝐻 = 0.5 rad, 𝑆 = 0.5 and
𝐼 = 0.3, respectively. If the pixel is converted to RGB color model, then the value
of the green pixel would be _____ (rounded off to 2 decimal places).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 0.28 to 0.32.

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section II (Image Processing and Analysis)
questions.questionText:
The brightness values of four pixels in the input image are shown in the table below.
The image is rectified using nearest neighbor intensity interpolation, and the pixel
at location (5, 4) in the output image is to be filled with the value from coordinate
(5.3, 3.7) in the input image. The brightness value of the pixel at location (5, 4) in
the rectified output image is ______ (Answer in integer).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 11 to 11.

questions.sectionName: Part B: Section II (Image Processing and Analysis)
questions.questionText:
The error matrix resulting from randomly selected test pixels for a classified image
is given below. The Producer’s accuracy of class 1 is ___________% (rounded off
to 1 decimal place).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 90.0 to 91.0.
